manifest.name: Minimal Writer
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Rebrands as a minimalist writing app with clean typography and simplified interface

css: .minimal-writer-active { font-family: 'Georgia', 'Times New Roman', serif !important; } .minimal-writer-active .card-detail-body { font-size: 18px !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; max-width: 650px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; } .minimal-writer-active .card-title { font-size: 32px !important; font-weight: 300 !important; letter-spacing: -0.02em !important; margin-bottom: 24px !important; } .minimal-writer-active button, .minimal-writer-active .btn { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif !important; } .minimal-writer-active .header { background: transparent !important; border: none !important; } .minimal-writer-badge { position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; font-size: 11px; color: #999; font-family: monospace; z-index: 9999; opacity: 0.5; } .minimal-writer-badge:hover { opacity: 1; }
